summary: Women and girls in Armenia and Georgia face significant risks of gender-based violence. The Safe YOU mobile application and web platform aim to prevent and protect them by providing a multifunctional safety tool. Users can send free alert SMS with their geolocation to up to 7 prechosen contacts, including the police. The platform also offers a network of women's rights NGOs, governmental organizations, and individual specialists providing support services. Users can engage in anonymous peer-to-peer discussions and get consultation from verified consultants. The application is designed to ensure safety and access to resources for all women and girls. It operates in the context of low-income countries, specifically targeting the needs of women and girls in Armenia and Georgia. The project addresses the sectors of gender equality, women's empowerment, and human rights.
